continuation.text:
I removed the Friday restriction from `suggest_slots` in `src/solution.py`. Previously, on Fridays the code cut the working day to end at 15:00, so Friday meetings had to end by 15:00. Fridays now use the same 09:00–17:00 hours as every other day. I didn't run or write any checks.

Everything else is unchanged: the 15-minute slot granularity, the 12:00–13:00 lunch block, the merging of overlapping events, and back-to-back meetings. The date still has to be a valid `YYYY-MM-DD` string.

I left the existing rule that rejects durations under 15 minutes, since you asked me to avoid unrelated changes. The current requirements don't mention it, so you may want to remove it too.
